details: Retrospective benchmark vs PROTAC-DB 3.0 (n=64): Spearman 0.243 (p=0.053), hit-rate 78% at 1000nM, systematic DC50 overestimate (median 173 vs 22 nM). Coarse potent/weak binning only.
validation_note: measured baseline; do not claim absolute DC50 accuracy

details: Chemprop D-MPNN trained on PROTAC-DB 3.0 (1,698 rows, scaffold split R2=0.52). Same 64-molecule benchmark: Spearman 0.758 (p<0.001) vs SynGlue baseline 0.243; hit<1000nM 93.8% vs 78%. Training on domain data is decisive.

Conformal-regression calibration (n=200 cal set) gives 92.2% coverage vs 90% target on 64 held-out PROTAC-DB molecules. Ensemble std alone uncalibrated (rho=0.086 vs error); AD nn-Tanimoto is the strongest trust signal (far bin RMSE 0.88 vs near 0.50). ICM warhead correctly flagged out_of_domain.
